"Nightbird" is a 1983 song by the American singer-songwriter Stevie Nicks, written by Nicks with Sandy Stewart.

Background The song was written as a continuation of themes explored in "Edge of Seventeen," namely "the difficulties of female rock 'n' roll singers." In a 1983 MTV interview, Nicks said "Nightbird" was her favorite song from the new album.
